title: Order History
description: A shopper's past orders, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Badge, Button, Card and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading and a short description, then one Card per order with its number, a status Badge, the date placed, the total and a "View order" Button over one line per item (its image, name, quantity and price), with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the date and total sit side by side with the button beside them and the images grow at @sm, each line's quantity moves into its own column and the heading steps up at @md, and the section gains room above, below and between the orders at @lg.
